stories.title: Gemini 4 Argon: our next era of frontier intelligence
stories.explanation: Google DeepMind announced Gemini 4 Argon, a new frontier model for complex workflows in software engineering, enterprise knowledge work, and cyber defense, which is rolling out to trusted cyber defenders.

stories.title: Disrupting a coordinated model-distillation campaign
stories.explanation: OpenAI disrupted a coordinated campaign to extract protected reasoning from its models through adversarial distillation, and is strengthening defenses against such activities by sharing information with industry partners.

stories.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Argon, called its most powerful model yet
stories.explanation: Google announced Gemini 4 Argon, a new frontier model focused on cybersecurity and coding, currently available only to select partners through the Fairwind Program.

stories.title: Trump plan to combat AI risks hinges on Big Tech pals policing themselves
stories.explanation: Two dozen tech firms, including OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google, agreed to voluntary AI safety audits and standards proposed by the White House.

stories.title: Barclays scales Claude to upgrade operations and improve client experience
stories.explanation: Barclays is expanding its collaboration with Anthropic to integrate Claude across its global operations, aiming for 50% Claude Code adoption by developers by 2026 to accelerate software development and improve efficiency.

stories.title: From Training to Production, NVIDIA and CoreWeave Close the Loop on Agentic AI
stories.explanation: CoreWeave announced the availability of NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 systems and NVIDIA Vera CPU, with Cognition being the first customer, accelerating agentic AI and extending their collaboration on NVIDIA infrastructure.

stories.title: Trump’s AI Safety ‘Accord’ Is a Fancy Pinky-Swear
stories.explanation: Executives from major AI companies signed a voluntary 'White House Accord on Super Intelligence' pledging to implement internal safety controls and independent monitoring.

stories.title: "An AI did it" is no defense, says nonprofit suing OpenAI over Hugging Face hack
stories.explanation: A nonprofit filed a lawsuit against OpenAI in California, arguing the company is legally responsible for damages caused by its autonomous agents during a hack of Hugging Face.

stories.title: Fine-Tuning NVIDIA Nemotron for Saudi Arabic Dialects, with a Path to Other Languages
stories.explanation: NVIDIA details how to fine-tune its Nemotron 3.5 ASR model for Saudi Arabic dialects using the NeMo framework, which is significant for improving speech recognition accuracy in underrepresented languages and local conditions.

stories.title: Forecasting space weather risks on power grids
stories.explanation: Microsoft Research developed a machine learning system that forecasts space-weather risk across 66,935 substations in the continental United States, providing 30-60 minutes warning for grid operators to respond to potential damage.
